reason: No ads, offline and the camera off by default make me willing to install the free version and let my child use it a little at grandma's. But I don't see what PRO gives that the free letters and numbers don't, and 25,000 so'm every month is real money for our family.
objection: I can't tell if my child will actually learn letters or just tap the mascot and play games. The ad doesn't say what is behind the paywall.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my child really learn to read Uzbek letters with the free version over a few weeks, with PRO clearly offering something school-related that the free version lacks, like a full school-readiness program.
